turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a and an?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you first. I eat ___ apple. I look at the next word: apple. It starts with an "a" sound. So I write "an": I eat an apple.
Use an before a, e, i, o, u sounds, and a before other sounds.
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: I have an pen.
Now you. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
